title: Scaffold the Cargo crate
notes: Created Cargo.toml (crate name 'amp', edition 2021, no dependencies; empty [workspace] table to detach from an enclosing cargo workspace found outside the project root) and src/lib.rs with the public API surface: AMP_VERSION const, AmpMessage struct, amp_encode, amp_decode, amp_decode_arg.

title: Implement the amp library
notes: Translated the REAL C source (not the planning assumptions): 1-byte header (version<<4 | argc), then per-arg 4-byte BE length + raw bytes. amp_encode(argv: &[&str]) -> Vec<u8>; amp_decode(buf: &[u8]) -> AmpMessage { version: u16, argc: u16, buf: Vec<u8>, pos: usize }; amp_decode_arg(&mut AmpMessage) -> Vec<u8> reads BE u32 length, copies bytes, advances cursor. No unsafe, no raw pointers, no external dependencies.

title: Port tests/test.c to Rust
notes: tests/amp.rs: single #[test] mirroring the C test exactly — encode ["some","stuff","here"], assert version==1 and argc==3, decode the three args via amp_decode_arg and assert they equal "some", "stuff", "here".

title: Build and test verification
notes: cargo build: Finished dev profile, exit 0. cargo test: 1 passed; 0 failed (integration test encode_decode_round_trip ok; 0 unit tests, 0 doc-tests). Byte-compatible with the C wire format.
